new_gaps.title: Draft edits and confirmation are not tied to a reviewed content version
new_gaps.codex_independent_finding: execute reads payload before conditional status claim; revision writes by id without expected payload/version/status. Device A can confirm an old preview after B edits the same action, or an in-flight revision can overwrite payload after confirm has read/claimed it. Conditional confirm/dismiss protection does not cover revision. This is a source-supported race risk, not a reproduced exploit.
new_gaps.remaining_uncertainty: Runtime interleaving and UI impact not reproduced.
new_gaps.acceptance_criteria: Client submits reviewed action revision/content hash; atomic owner/status/revision/expiry claim; revision CAS rejects EXECUTING and stale base; persisted snapshot equals confirmed preview; lost update test across two DB clients.

new_gaps.title: Workflow revision counter is incremented but does not prevent lost slot updates
new_gaps.codex_independent_finding: workflowStateRepository.update writes slotsJson by id and optionally increments revision without comparing expected revision. Unique active workflow prevents duplicate rows, not two turns replacing each other's captured fields.
new_gaps.remaining_uncertainty: No real two-device execution; exact affected call-site set needs integration tracing.
new_gaps.acceptance_criteria: Two concurrent distinct corrections either merge without dropping fields or one receives explicit conflict/reload. State predicates cover lifecycle transitions; do not merely add another counter.

new_gaps.title: Service-like model endpoints accept ordinary end-user tokens outside per-user generation buckets
new_gaps.codex_independent_finding: Router-wide requireAuth accepts normal bearer JWTs. analyze-cycle/assess-cycle/analyze-feedback/generate-client-plan-draft/generate-roadmap-draft/explain-exercise-progression omit the limiter used by ask/generate-workout. Client-plan controller passes validated body userId and context to LLM generation without service-only enforcement. An authenticated caller can reach these model-call paths without consuming ai-ask/ai-expensive buckets. This is a local-route policy gap; API Gateway/WAF exposure and deployment limits are unknown. It does not demonstrate access to another client's stored data, because this sampled generator consumes submitted payload.
new_gaps.remaining_uncertainty: No request executed, costs incurred or external route exposure tested; no customer data read.
new_gaps.acceptance_criteria: Classify each endpoint trusted-service-only versus public; enforce that boundary in service. Public endpoints bind identity/accounting to verified caller and consume shared distributed quota/cost budget. Negative JWT/service-secret/rate-budget bypass tests and actual deployed routing evidence.
